• **Assign** a primary and backup coach to each centre at least 2 weeks before program start, with confirmed availability calendars.

• **Create** a simple handover document coaches must complete after each session (attendance, issues, next coach details) to catch consistency problems early.

• **Establish** a minimum 2-session overlap when transitioning between coaches so knowledge transfers and relationships with centres aren't disrupted.
